description: Four-panel summary figure: LPA/LPAL2/PLG locus map, LPAL2 transcript ORF and stop codon map, kringle identity to apo(a) vs plasminogen, and the neutral-rate test of nonsynonymous divergence
code:
import requests, json, time, math, os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
s = requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})

# ---------- data assembled from the preceding analyses ----------
exon_lens=[49,160,182,158,182,160,182,158,181,160,179,149,94,121,107,117,159]
cum=np.cumsum([0]+exon_lens)
stops=[222,246,288,297,372,402,412,435,442,468,473,485,523,577,615,636,638,640,656,659,669,710,729,745,757,828,829]

kr = pd.DataFrame([
 ("apo(a) KIV-9",84.8),("apo(a) KIV-6",83.5),("apo(a) KIV-3",83.5),("apo(a) KIV-4",83.5),
 ("apo(a) KIV-2",83.5),("apo(a) KIV-5",83.5),("apo(a) KIV-7",83.5),("apo(a) KIV-8",83.5),
 ("apo(a) KIV-10",79.7),("apo(a) KIV-1",79.7),("apo(a) K15",78.5),("apo(a) K11",74.7),
 ("apo(a) K14",73.4),("apo(a) K12",73.4),("apo(a) K13",72.2),("PLG K4",71.8),
 ("PLG K3",53.8),("PLG K2",53.2),("PLG K5",52.5),("PLG K1",51.9),("apo(a) KV-like",46.9)],
 columns=["domain","pid"])

neut = pd.DataFrame([
 ("human vs chimp",512.0,8.0,7.8,151.0,8.0,2.3),
 ("human vs bonobo",504.7,7.0,7.7,149.3,8.0,2.3),
 ("human vs gorilla",513.0,11.5,10.2,150.0,11.5,3.0)],
 columns=["pair","N","Nd_obs","Nd_exp","S","Sd_obs","Sd_exp"])

stop_ctx = {"human":"CTCAGACAA GAA TAG GGCTGT","chimpanzee":"CTCAGACCA GAA TAG GGCTGT",
            "bonobo":"CTCAGACCA GAA TAG GGCTGT","gorilla":"CTCGGACAA GAA TAG GGCTGT"}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,11.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3,2, height_ratios=[1.0,1.15,1.0], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.25)

# --- A: locus map + transcript ORF map ---
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
axA.set_title("A. LPAL2 is a 17 exon transcribed pseudogene in the LPA/PLG cluster on chromosome 6q25.3", loc="left", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
for (name,st,en,col,strand) in [("LPAL2 (pseudogene)",160453428,160511007,"#B3261E",-1),
                                ("LPA (protein coding)",160531482,160664276,"#1F6FEB",-1),
                                ("PLG (protein coding)",160702105,160754469,"#2E7D32",1)]:
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((st,0.55),en-st,0.18,color=col))
    axA.text((st+en)/2,0.80,name+("  <--" if strand<0 else "  -->"),ha="center",fontsize=9,color=col)
axA.set_xlim(160.44e6,160.77e6); axA.set_ylim(0,1.5)
axA.set_yticks([]); axA.set_xlabel("GRCh38 chromosome 6 coordinate (bp)")
axA.ticklabel_format(axis="x", style="plain")
axA.text(160.445e6,0.25,"LPAL2 and LPA lie head-to-tail on the minus strand; all three share plasminogen kringle ancestry",fontsize=9,color="0.35")
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: axA.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- B: transcript map with ORF and in-frame stops ---
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
axB.set_title("B. The LPAL2 transcript ENST00000454031 (2498 nt) carries 27 in-frame stop codons; the ORF ends after 222 codons", loc="left", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(cum[:-1],cum[1:])):
    axB.add_patch(Rectangle((a,0.42),b-a-4,0.16,color="#5A5A5A" if i%2 else "#8A8A8A"))
    axB.text((a+b)/2,0.62,str(i+1),ha="center",fontsize=7,color="0.3")
axB.add_patch(Rectangle((0,0.22),669,0.12,color="#1F6FEB",alpha=.85))
axB.text(334,0.08,"ORF from annotated ATG: 222 codons (27% of transcript)",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#1F6FEB")
axB.add_patch(Rectangle((0,0.22),398,0.12,color="#B3261E",alpha=.95))
axB.text(200,0.36,"Q16609 (132 aa)",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="white",fontweight="bold")
for st in stops:
    axB.plot([st*3],[0.70],marker="v",color="#B3261E",ms=6)
axB.text(760,0.74,"each triangle = an in-frame stop codon (n = 27)",fontsize=9,color="#B3261E")
axB.set_xlim(-30,2530); axB.set_ylim(0,0.9); axB.set_yticks([])
axB.set_xlabel("position in spliced transcript (nt)")
for sp in ["top","right","left"]: axB.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- C: kringle identity ---
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
kr2=kr.sort_values("pid")
cols=["#1F6FEB" if d.startswith("apo(a)") else "#2E7D32" for d in kr2.domain]
axC.barh(kr2.domain, kr2.pid, color=cols)
axC.set_xlabel("percent identity to the Q16609 kringle (Smith-Waterman, BLOSUM62)")
axC.set_title("C. The Q16609 kringle is an apo(a) kringle IV copy", loc="left", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
axC.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=7); axC.set_xlim(0,95)
axC.axvline(71.8, ls="--", color="0.5", lw=1)
axC.text(72.5, 1.0, "best plasminogen match\n(PLG kringle 4, 71.8%)", fontsize=7.5, color="0.35")
for sp in ["top","right"]: axC.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- D: neutral-rate test ---
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
x=np.arange(len(neut)); w=0.2
axD.bar(x-1.5*w, neut.Nd_obs, w, color="#B3261E", label="nonsynonymous observed")
axD.bar(x-0.5*w, neut.Nd_exp, w, color="#B3261E", alpha=.35, label="nonsynonymous expected if neutral")
axD.bar(x+0.5*w, neut.Sd_obs, w, color="#1F6FEB", label="synonymous observed")
axD.bar(x+1.5*w, neut.Sd_exp, w, color="#1F6FEB", alpha=.35, label="synonymous expected if neutral")
axD.set_xticks(x); axD.set_xticklabels(neut.pair, fontsize=9)
axD.set_ylabel("substitutions in the LPAL2 ORF region (codons 1 to 221)")
axD.set_title("D. Nonsynonymous change matches the local neutral rate", loc="left", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
axD.legend(fontsize=7.5, frameon=False, loc="upper left")
for i,r in neut.iterrows():
    axD.text(i-1.0*w, max(r.Nd_obs,r.Nd_exp)+0.5, f"obs/exp\n{r.Nd_obs/r.Nd_exp:.2f}", ha="center", fontsize=7.5, color="#B3261E")
axD.text(0.02,0.52,"local neutral rate taken from 6 kb of LPAL2 intron\nin the same EPO primate alignment (1.52% human-chimp)",
         transform=axD.transAxes, fontsize=7.5, color="0.35")
for sp in ["top","right"]: axD.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.show()

# save provenance tables in the executor output directory
outdir = os.getcwd()
kr.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir,"LPAL2_kringle_identity.csv"), index=False)
neut.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir,"LPAL2_neutral_rate_test.csv"), index=False)
print("saved tables to", outdir, os.listdir(outdir)[:20])
print("\nShared premature stop codon context (exon 5, reading frame of the annotated ORF):")
for k,v in stop_ctx.items(): print(f"  {k:12s} {v}")
